deal: Calderwood Bank is lending US$250 million against a pool of auto loans.
intake: First, the documents. Artizent's AI sorts the pack and spots a missing schedule.
terms: Next, the terms. The AI drafts each one and shows exactly where it came from.
ontology: The AI is grounded in Artizent's Facility Ontology, so it knows what each term means.
facility: Code then checks every answer. This one came from a poor scan, so it is flagged.
amended: The amended advance rate is already applied, with its source. The analyst approves it.
bulk: Routine terms are approved together. A person approves every term.
rules: The AI turns the schedules into rules, each tied to concepts in the ontology.
ruleEdit: Changing a rule shows its effect first, and needs a second analyst.
mapping: The AI maps the loan tape to the platform, using the same ontology.
validation: Now the proof. No AI here: the rules engine checks every loan, to the cent.
bridge: The borrower overstated its pool by US$1.24 million. Every dollar is explained.
drill: Six loans share three cars. The same car may have been pledged twice.
queue: Anything doubtful goes to one queue. The analyst decides each item.
sunrise: Two spellings, one dealer. That breaks a limit and cuts availability to US$193,347.
approve: Then approval. The person who prepared the case cannot approve it.
reviewer: A second analyst checks every change, then approves.
approved: The verified data is released, with a full audit trail.
results: Measured, not forecast: all 10 issues found, no false alarms, every key term right.
